base: Amount of the inventory of the succession (La. C.C.P. art. 3351).

schedules.who: Executor/administrator commission (La. C.C.P. art. 3351) (default rate; court may increase)
schedules.text: 2.5% of the amount of the inventory, absent a testamentary provision or agreement; the court may increase it upon proof it is inadequate (La. C.C.P. art. 3351).
